ci_gate.mechanism: tests/cbmc-current-main-t4.test.mjs treats a dependency-import failure as a hard failure under any accepted CI environment signal, so the MCP stdio integration test can no longer silently skip in CI; a local optional skip remains for offline environments. Accepted signals (R148 P1-01): CI=true, CI=woodpecker, or any CI_PIPELINE_* variable — the previous CI=true-only check misdetected official Woodpecker pipelines, which set CI=woodpecker and CI_PIPELINE_* but not CI=true, so a missing-dependency skip would have stayed silent in CI.

ci_gate.negative_example_mechanism: Each negative example re-runs the REAL committed test file (tests/cbmc-current-main-t4.test.mjs, unmodified bytes) in a child process with a module hook registered via node:module register() that makes '@modelcontextprotocol/server' unresolvable with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND, faithfully reproducing the missing-dependency condition even where a parent node_modules provides the package. Probe children set CBMC_T4_GATE_PROBE=1 so the negative examples do not recurse, and they strip CI, CI_PIPELINE_* and NODE_TEST_* variables so the child behaves as a standalone run with the spec reporter. The three CI-signal probes assert nonzero exit, the MCP_LOCKED_DEPENDENCIES_UNAVAILABLE_IN_CI marker, and the absence of any skip directive; the local probe asserts exit 0, the skipped MCP stdio test line, and fail 0.
